title: A redesigned Image Translator
summary: A redesigned Image Translator with Regenerate, a full-page QC report and Sync from TM, style guides beside your terms, and 500 MB uploads for Word and PowerPoint translation.

items.title: A redesigned analyze page.
items.body: The image is on the left, layers in the middle and controls on the right, in columns you can resize or collapse.

children.body: An aspect ratio dropdown that shows each option's output size.
A **Restyle with AI** panel with starter prompts.
Undo and redo for the brush, and an enlarged preview of the image.
Layers whose text or colour you edited are marked.

items.title: A redesigned review page.
items.body: Tabs switch between Compare, Image view, Version history and Usage, with **Back Translation** and **AI Report** beside them.

children.body: AI Suggestions and AI Proofreading are their own tabs and follow the layer you select.
Source and translation side by side, with synced zoom and pan.
Every phrase in one scrolling list, with a sticky header.
Change a translated layer's colour straight from Compare.
Add a language without leaving the page.

items.title: Regenerate after you edit.
items.body: A **Regenerate** button renders your corrections and shows how many edits are waiting.

items.title: A full-page QC report.
items.body: Confirm the run first, then read the Report and Issues tabs, with **Fix all** on Issues. Check only unverified layers or all of them.

items.title: Sync from TM.
items.body: Pull your memory's wording and review status onto every layer it knows, after a confirm. Layers the memory hasn't seen are left as they are.

items.title: Usage shows words alongside credits,
items.body: with a Proofreaders contribution panel.

items.title: A focused view for proofreaders.
items.body: Members assigned to a language don't see Add language, Assign or Usage, and open on the latest version.

items.title: Assign by the language on screen.
items.body: The assign dialog in the image translator covers only the language you're looking at. The process list and the editor now share the same searchable member picker.

items.title: Read a memory's style guide in the app.
items.body: A **Style guide** tab sits beside the terms in the editor drawer. VitraTM style guides display in the app; Phrase style guides open through a direct link.
A memory on the Microsoft Translator engine warns that its style guide is ignored.

items.title: Upload files up to 500 MB.
items.body: Word and PowerPoint files upload straight to storage with a progress bar, up to 500 MB each and 2 GB per batch.

items.title: The preview docks beside the editor.
items.body: Selecting a phrase scrolls the preview to its slide.

items.title: Indic text displays in translated decks.
items.body: Translated Telugu, Hindi, Bengali and other Indic text now uses a font that has those scripts, instead of the deck's own font, which couldn't show them.

items.title: **Sync to TM** stayed disabled after QC Fix All, AI Suggestions or AI Proofreading.
items.body: It's now available after each of these, and so is **Regenerate**.

items.title: Picking a version in Version history did nothing,
items.body: worst in Fast Mode. Selecting one now switches back to the image.

items.title: Undo and redo were always disabled.
items.body: They now cover text, colour, lock and delete edits, and an undone edit stays undone after a reload.

items.title: Text edits leaked into other languages.
items.body: An edit now stays with the language you made it in.

items.title: AI Suggestions could show another layer.
items.body: The panel now follows the layer you selected.

items.title: Untranslated layers showed the source text as their translation.
items.body: They are now empty, with the source as a hint.

items.title: The downloaded QC report PDF was squashed and missing the source image.
items.body: It now keeps the desktop layout with both images, and scrolling during the download no longer reveals a copy of the report.

items.title: Smaller Image Translator fixes.

children.body: A failed re-analysis no longer clears your master prompt.
**Apply changes** appears once, in the side panel, and re-analyses instead of re-translating the whole image.
Back Translation shows a run in progress instead of offering a new one.
Adding a language shows as "Translated to" in Version history, not "Annotation edit".
Point and area annotations have a box to type your instruction.
**Run in background** no longer lands on "Analysis result not found".
The Approved badge keeps its colour under your organization's branding.
Compare columns no longer squeeze when the side navigation is open.

items.title: The Translate Photo dashboard's Recent list was empty,
items.body: and a failed analysis showed as in progress. Recent work, including image translations, now lists, and a failed analysis shows as failed.
